title: Vasco and Vitória Face Off in Copa do Brasil Semifinal
seoTitle: Vasco vs Vitória: Copa do Brasil Semifinal Clash
subtitle: The match will decide who reaches the final of the national tournament
excerpt: The Vasco vs Vitória match, set for Wednesday at 9:30 PM at Barradão, is all about securing a spot in the Copa do Brasil 2026 final.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The clash between Vasco and Vitória, marking the second leg of the Copa do Brasil 2026 semifinal, is drawing significant attention as it's decisive for a spot in the final. The match is scheduled for Wednesday at 9:30 PM at Barradão and will be broadcast live by TV Globo, Premiere, Sportv, ge tv, and Amazon Prime, with live text commentary and exclusive videos available on ge.

Vitória and Vasco Prepare for Decisive Showdown

Vitória enters the second leg with three consecutive defeats, including a loss to Atlético-MG at the end of the month. The club has secured only three wins in 11 matches in the second half of the year, putting pressure on the team. Vasco, on the other hand, has regained form, winning the first leg of the tie and defeating Cruzeiro in the Brasileirão. Coach Pedro Emanuel remains undefeated in knockout rounds.

Team Developments

For Vitória, Brítez and Caíque Gonçalves are suspended, and Mateus Silva is expected to play on the right. Walace is the primary midfield option, while Gabriel Baralhas remains a doubt. Renê and Renato Kayzer could be used as a striking duo, similar to the return leg of the Round of 16 against Athletico.

For Vasco, Barros is suspended after receiving a red card in the first leg, and Lucas Piton replaces Cuiabano. Pedro Emanuel might once again field two players on the right flank. Vasco's probable lineup includes Léo Jardim in goal, Paulo Henrique, Cuesta, Robert Renan, and Lucas Piton in midfield, and Tchê Tchê, Thiago Mendes, and Adson up front.

Impact of the Result on the Copa do Brasil

Vitória won the first leg 1-0, but conceded a goal in the return leg, which sends the game to extra time and, if necessary, penalties. Vitória needs to win by two goals to advance in regular time. Vasco, with their victory in the first leg, has the advantage of advancing if the final score is 1-0 in their favor.

Odds and Betting Implications

Bookmakers are offering favorable odds for Vitória, with +123 for the club's victory in the match. Statistical analysis suggests Vitória has a 44.8% chance of winning, with an estimated real probability of 50%. Bettors can also explore markets for partial results and total goals.

Conclusion

The clash between Vasco and Vitória represents a crucial moment in the Copa do Brasil 2026, with each team looking to solidify its path to the final. The match promises tactical strategies, suspensions, and the possibility of deciding the clubs' fate in a high-stakes encounter.
